entries.what: NVIDIA's hosted meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct has reached end of life, so requests to integrate.api.nvidia.com with it return HTTP 410. The model page gives 08/25/2026, and the API's own answer says 2026-08-26T09:00:00Z.

source.quote: It will no longer be supported after 08/25/2026.

lookFor: The model ID meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct in a request to integrate.api.nvidia.com. Not the same weights served by another host.
entries.replacement: None listed on the provider page when this was added
